scenes.stage_direction: The room grows quieter as live contact approaches. The last call is real; physical reunion is still beyond this campaign.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Her statement and Ethan's current placement are secured.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: You said tomorrow. Tell me what tomorrow means.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: A named authority, a place and a supervised return assessment. We are waiting for the notice.

metadata.evidence_summary: The next operation has a named place, witness and authority.
